Mixed reactions to Roma's draw: Allegri furious, Gasperini cautious

Yahoo Sports reported that Allegri was enraged after the 3-3 draw with Napoli, stating, 'Maybe I shouldn't be on the touchline.' ESPN Singapore's Burley noted the difficulty in distinguishing whether Manchester United were good or Roma were bad in the match. Conversely, Football Italia's Carrick praised Roma as a 'really good team,' while Hooligan Soccer called the result a 'Roma Gift' rather than a United win. On the other end, Udinese's Runjaic claimed Roma exploited every mistake, and Gasperini warned the team about being 'goal-crazed' in a European clash.
